title: rustle benchmark results of one campaign
description: The published benchmark numbers of one campaign: rustle against 3proxy, Squid, gost and Tinyproxy. The conditions are in the campaign's campaign.json, the competitors in its proxies.json. Generated by bench/tools/site-data.py from the campaign indexes; read by the rustle website at the release tag.

$schema.title: Schema pointer
$schema.description: Relative path to this schema, for editors.

schema_version.title: Schema version
schema_version.description: Version of this contract. A breaking change bumps it; readers must refuse a version they do not know.

campaign.title: Campaign
campaign.description: Id of the campaign (its folder name under bench/data/ and bench/published/). Conditions are in that folder's campaign.json; numbers are not comparable across campaigns.

tests.title: Tests
tests.description: One entry per published metric, in reading order.

scaling.title: Multi-core scaling
scaling.description: Throughput against the number of proxy cores.

items.title: Scaling series
items.description: One metric measured for 1, 2, 4 and 8 cores.

ktls.title: Kernel TLS
ktls.description: rustle with tls.ktls off and on, on the tests of the TLS matrix.

proxyId.title: Proxy id
proxyId.description: Identifier of a compared proxy. A new proxy is added here (and to the by-proxy maps): an additive change.

direction.title: Direction
direction.description: Which way is better: higher or lower values.

nullableNumber.title: Number or null
nullableNumber.description: A measured value, or null when there is none.

nullableInteger.title: Integer or null
nullableInteger.description: A connection count, or null when not applicable.

nullableString.title: String or null
nullableString.description: Text, or null when there is none.

valuesByProxy.title: Values by proxy
valuesByProxy.description: One measured value per proxy; null when the proxy has no number (see status). Keys are the proxies of the campaign (proxies.json); the check requires exactly those.

connsByProxy.title: Connection level by proxy
connsByProxy.description: Concurrency level of the best clean point, per proxy; null when not applicable. Keys are the proxies of the campaign (proxies.json); the check requires exactly those.

status.title: Status
status.description: ok: a clean number. unsupported: the proxy cannot do the test (no listener, no WebSocket). not_measured: it could, but was not run. invalid: client errors, not publishable.

statusByProxy.title: Status by proxy
statusByProxy.description: Why a proxy has, or has not, a number. Keys are the proxies of the campaign (proxies.json); the check requires exactly those.

flagList.title: Flags
flagList.description: proxy_unsaturated: the proxy used under 90 % of its core at that point (the harness or the test network set the number). harness_saturated: the origin or the sink was above 90 %.

flagsByProxy.title: Flags by proxy
flagsByProxy.description: Saturation flags of each proxy's point. Keys are the proxies of the campaign (proxies.json); the check requires exactly those.

test.title: Test
test.description: One metric measured for every proxy.

transport.title: Transport
transport.description: How the client reaches the proxy.

conditions.title: Conditions
conditions.description: A sentence to print next to the number: workload and transport.

chart.title: Chart
chart.description: File name of the chart in bench/charts/, or null.

values.title: Values
values.description: The measured value of each proxy.

at_conns.title: Connections
at_conns.description: Concurrency level of each proxy's best point.

status.title: Status
status.description: Why a proxy has, or has not, a number.

flags.title: Flags
flags.description: Saturation flags of each proxy's point.

cpu_us.title: CPU per request
cpu_us.description: Microseconds of proxy CPU per request or message at each proxy's best point (http, ws-64b, ws-short tests).

cpu_ms_per_gb.title: CPU per GB
cpu_ms_per_gb.description: Milliseconds of proxy CPU per decimal gigabyte moved at each proxy's best point (tunnels and 64 KB WebSocket frames).

p99_ms.title: p99 latency
p99_ms.description: p99 latency in milliseconds at each proxy's best point (WebSocket tests).

proxy_util.title: Proxy utilisation
proxy_util.description: Proxy CPU over the cores it was given at each proxy's best point, 0 to 1.

scalingPoint.title: Scaling point
scalingPoint.description: The result for one core count.

values.title: Values
values.description: The measured value of each proxy.

at_conns.title: Connections
at_conns.description: Concurrency level of each proxy's best point.

flags.title: Flags
flags.description: Saturation flags of each proxy's point.

proxy_util.title: Proxy utilisation
proxy_util.description: Proxy CPU over the cores it was given, 0 to 1.

origin_util.title: Origin utilisation
origin_util.description: Origin CPU over its threads, 0 to 1.

scalingSeries.title: Scaling series
scalingSeries.description: One metric measured for several core counts.

not_measured.title: Not measured
not_measured.description: Proxies left out of the series.

points.title: Points
points.description: One point per core count, ascending.

items.title: Point
items.description: The result for one core count.

ktlsEntry.title: kTLS comparison
ktlsEntry.description: One metric of the TLS matrix for rustle with user-space TLS and with kernel TLS.

id.title: Id
id.description: Id of the matching tls-* test.

user_space.title: User-space TLS
user_space.description: rustle with tls.ktls = false (rustls in user space).

user_space_cpu_ms_per_gb.title: CPU per GB, user-space TLS
user_space_cpu_ms_per_gb.description: Milliseconds of proxy CPU per decimal gigabyte with tls.ktls = false (tunnel test only).

ktls_cpu_ms_per_gb.title: CPU per GB, kernel TLS
ktls_cpu_ms_per_gb.description: Milliseconds of proxy CPU per decimal gigabyte with tls.ktls = true (tunnel test only).
